# quuxplusone.github.io

> A collection of interactive games, word puzzles, and C++ educational resources by Arthur O'Dwyer.

This site features classic game ports and modern word puzzle games alongside technical educational content focused on C++ standard library implementation. The projects span retro gaming preservation and contemporary programming education.

## Key Topics

- Adventure game
- Word games
- Interactive fiction
- C++ standard library
- Game ports
- Scrabble
- Wordle
- Text adventure
- Z-machine
- Crowther and Woods
- Anagram generator
- Hands-on course
- Retro gaming
- Arthur O'Dwyer

## Educational Resources

- [The Standard Library From Scratch](https://quuxplusone.github.io/from-scratch/): Hands-on C++ standard library implementation workshop course

## Interactive Games

- [Adventure](https://quuxplusone.github.io/Advent/): Port of classic Adventure game by Crowther and Woods
- [Birdle](https://quuxplusone.github.io/wordle-clone/birdle/): Bird-themed Wordle clone with daily five-letter word puzzles

## Word Puzzles & Tools

- [Scrabblegrams](https://quuxplusone.github.io/Scrabblegrams/): Interactive Scrabble anagram generator and word puzzle tool
